title: Pandolfi email: senators let him carry the keys

tellings.quote: Ron, there's even an email I have where Ron says uh these senators and congressmen, they're they're always uh asking these questions and they they don't realize that it's it's not the material, it's the access to the material and you can get in a lot of trouble and I tell the senators that and they just let me carry the keys.

plain: In an email, a CIA scientist named Ron Pandolfi is said to have written that senators and congressmen keep asking questions about UFOs without realising the real issue is not the material itself but access to it, that you can get into a lot of trouble, and that when he tells the senators this "they just let me carry the keys." The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says he has this email, and he quotes it from memory without showing it. If true, it would mean one official, not Congress, holds the keys to what is known.
